newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African shares futures up on Dow, golds firmer.
newsitem.headline: S.African shares futures up on Dow, golds firmer.

text.p: 0714 GMT - South African shares open firm driven by a strong Wall Street which leapt over 179 points overnight -- its second biggest one-day point gain. Gold contracts a little firmer on a better bullion price, which holds its head above $340.
Dealers say volumes mederate and market seen volatile during the day with good two-way trade. Cash market seen opening strong.
The June all-share contract stands at 6,653/64 from 6,606, the industrial contract is at 8,366/75 from 8,310 and the gold contract is at 845/48 from 841.
